📉 Nearly 4 million people in UK face destitution, including 1 million children Britain’s destitution crisis remains at record levels, with 3.8 million people unable to afford basic necessities such as food, heating, clothing and hygiene products in 2025, Sky News reported, citing research funded by the Joseph Rowntree Foundation (JRF). 🌏 The number of people experiencing destitution has nearly tripled since 2017 , remaining at the record levels reached in 2022. 🌏 Greater London recorded the highest regional rate of destitution, with around 2% of households affected, rising to over 3% in Newham . 🌏 Those affected are increasingly dependent on food banks and other emergency support services. 💬 “Without action, we risk destitution becoming the norm for millions in the UK,” warned Julian Hartley, group chief executive of JRF.
